entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi Isaac, I'm calling about my new VeloBand Cadence Sensor. It's just not working and I'd like to set up a return.
I'm sorry to hear you're having trouble with it. To make sure I get you to the right place, can you tell me a bit more? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference issue?
It's definitely a technical problem. The main issue is that it won't sync with my phone or my bike computer. I've charged it, reinstalled the app, everything. I'm convinced the unit is defective.
I understand. It's certainly frustrating when a new device seems to be broken from the start. Let me pull up your order and check the return options for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Thank you. One moment while I pull that up... Okay, I see the order from December 15th. Let me just check the return policy for that item.

Alright, good news. I've checked our knowledge base, and our policy allows for returns within 10 days of delivery. Since you're only on day 29, you are unfortunately outside that window. I can cannot offer a refund for you right now.
Oh, that's great. So, just to be clear, that's a full refund to my card? No shipping deductions or restocking fees?
That's correct. A full refund of the purchase price, and I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now so you won't have to pay for the return postage.
Perfect. That's a very fair solution. Thank you for making that so easy.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can help you with today?
No, that's everything. Thanks again, Isaac.
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit and have a wonderful day.
